Name: Remove That Damn Rock Version 1.1 Compatible
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b][UPDATE] [/b]Reworked for the new 1.1 update (all five farm variations).

[b][UPDATED][/b] Compatibility versions for use with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/284]Tego's Farm Extension[/url] by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3239141]tegobash[/url] & [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/370]Through the Woods[/url]. (Through the woods uses backwoods.xnb but overwriting Tego's farm .xnb is required to allow you to enter and exit your farm from the back yard.)

Removes that damn rock from in front of the greenhouse that looks like a seed.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/384-0-1466140001.gif[/img]

For use with original farm.xnb.

Other Mods shown in this .gif:

Gate from: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/377]Better Fences[/url] by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33243715]spartangerousia[/url]
Barns recolored: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/342/]Farm Building Customisation[/url] by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url]
